user_query: I'm planning a movie night with my friends this weekend. Can you provide me with the showtimes of the latest films at the cinemas near my location? Also, suggest some popular film genres that we can choose from to make our movie night more exciting.

TaskList.description: Get the user's current location to find nearby cinemas.
Query the cinema APIs to retrieve the latest showtimes for films at cinemas near the user's location.
Research and compile a list of popular film genres for user selection.
